configuration.compileOnSave.enabled.mark: Always update the compiled PDF when a file is saved.
configuration.localReplica.syncOnFileCha: Upload the changes that other programs make to the files of a Local Replica as they happen, and scan the folder once a minute for a change the watcher missed. When this is off, saves in the editor, new files and removed files sync as they happen, and other changes are uploaded by "Sync Local Replica Now" or the command-line tool's `replica-sync`. Takes effect after the window reloads.
configuration.localReplica.fetchMode.mar: How a Local Replica takes in the changes made on Overleaf. In every mode it reads them over the editor's connection and records Overleaf's states as commits in the replica folder's git repository; `mixed` and `bridge` also bring in the commits of Overleaf's git bridge. Takes effect after the window reloads.
configuration.localReplica.fetchMode.nat: Overleaf's state, read over the editor's connection and recorded as local commits.
configuration.localReplica.fetchMode.mix: Native, and the git bridge's newest commit when git cannot merge Overleaf's state into the branch, when a document has conflicts, and on request.
configuration.localReplica.fetchMode.bri: Native, and the git bridge's newest commit for every new state. Each request to the bridge takes up to a minute.
configuration.localReplica.pushMode.mark: How a Local Replica sends its changes to Overleaf. Takes effect after the window reloads.
configuration.localReplica.pushMode.nati: Upload over the editor's connection, also as files change.
configuration.localReplica.pushMode.brid: Keep local changes local until git pushes them through Overleaf's git bridge (`replica-land --push bridge`, or git push).
configuration.compileOutputFolderName.ma: The name of the folder where the compiled output files (e.g., `output.pdf`) is located. (Take effect after restarting VSCode)
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.markdownD: Configure the color themes used by the PDF viewer. (Take effect after restarting VSCode)
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.fontColor: The font color of the theme.
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.backgroun: The background color of the theme.
configuration.pdfViewer.defaultScrollMod: Configure the default scroll mode used by the PDF viewer for new state. Existing saved viewer state takes precedence.
configuration.pdfViewer.defaultSpreadMod: Configure the default spread mode used by the PDF viewer for new state. Existing saved viewer state takes precedence.
configuration.pdfViewer.engine.markdownD: The PDF viewer. Both viewers load the project's compiled PDF in ranges with Overleaf's own loader, as Overleaf's web editor does, so a large PDF shows its first pages without being downloaded whole. A change applies to the open PDFs too: their viewers reload. Each viewer has a button that switches to the other one by changing this setting.
configuration.pdfViewer.engine.pdfjs: pdf.js 5.1.91's viewer, with its sidebar, find and page modes, on Overleaf's loader.
configuration.pdfViewer.engine.overleaf: Overleaf's viewer (its PDFJSWrapper on pdf.js 5.1.91) with a small toolbar and an outline, on Overleaf's loader.
configuration.pdfViewer.pieceCacheSizeMB: How many megabytes of compiled PDFs the PDF viewer keeps on disk, as the pieces that Overleaf's PDF caching names by their content. A later build then downloads only the pieces that changed, e.g. a book's text but not its images. `0` keeps none.
configuration.invisibleMode.historyRefre: The interval (in seconds) to refresh the project history in invisible mode, which is used to update the file changes, collaborator status, etc.
configuration.invisibleMode.chatMessageR: The interval (in seconds) to refresh the chat messages in invisible mode.
configuration.invisibleMode.inactiveTime: The timeout (in seconds) to mark a online Collaborator as inactivate in invisible mode.
